build_AppDriver: build a python module to instantiate an AppDriver with config, gui_input, line_render, text_drawer, and sim parameters
create_AppDriver_init: create an AppDriver instance that initializes networking, GUI drawer, user management, and UI manager from a habitat_hitl config
test_sim_update: test the abstract sim_update method in a subclass of AppDriver to handle simulation timestep updates
review_close: review the AppDriver close method that terminates the networking process when the network server is enabled
summarize_send_keyframes: summarize the _send_keyframes method that parses JSON keyframes, strips rig data if skinning is disabled, and sends them to the networking thread
